title: Time Travel
subtitle: Time Travel lets you undo your changes, including settings, spaces, and custom development.
noChangesMatch: No changes match that file filter.
noHistoryYet: No history yet. Make a change after Time Travel is enabled.
noVisibleChangedFiles: This point has no visible changed files after history ignore rules.
selectPoint: Select a point in time to inspect its changed files.
repositoryEyebrow: Select Time Travel scope (git repository folder)
noHistoryPointsYet: No history points yet. Save a file after Time Travel is enabled.
unableToFindRepositories: Unable to find writable Git repositories.
travelledInTime: Travelled in time. Other history points are still available.
revertedAsNewPoint: Reverted those changes as a new history point.
noTextDiff: No text diff is available for this file.
diffTooLarge: This diff is larger than 1 MB, so Time Travel will not render it.

modal.revertDescription: This will create a new history point that undoes the affected files below.
modal.travelDescription: This will move your files, settings, spaces, and custom development to match the affected files below.
